sar.narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT (SAR) - CASE HHG-010

REGULATORY JURISDICTION: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) / BSA

PART I: SUBJECT INFORMATION & ACCOUNT TOPOLOGY
Primary subject customer ID C10434, operating payment card account C10434-K1. Device profile recorded: 'Unknown Device'. Topological investigation identified a coordinated device nexus: the same hardware/browser signature is shared across 208 distinct payment cards and 208 distinct customer profiles, indicating syndicate compromise.

PART II: SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY SUMMARY & FINANCIAL EXPOSURE
Total identified fraudulent exposure amounts to $1,000.03 USD. The primary flagged transaction 3506725 occurred on 2016-12-02 18:18:27. Activity exhibits unauthorized electronic card-not-present exploitation under pattern classification 'card_not_present_new_device'.

PART III: CHRONOLOGY & TYPOLOGY PATTERN MECHANICS
Initial alert triggered via risk_score ('Real-time model scored transaction 3506725 ($1,000.03, online) at 0.90. Review and decide.'). Velocity analysis revealed 0 transaction(s) within the 1-hour window and 0 within 24 hours (velocity spike ratio: 0.0).

PART IV: INVESTIGATIVE FINDINGS, GRAPH EVIDENCE & POLICIES CITED
Graph traversal confirmed pattern typology 'card_not_present_new_device'. Filing is mandated pursuant to Bank Fraud Policy Section 3a (Confirmed Unauthorized Fraud), Policy Rule R2 (Customer Disavowal), and Policy Rule R6 (Syndicate Multi-Card Compromise).

PART V: ACTIONS TAKEN & RECOMMENDED DISPOSITION
The financial institution has immediately blocked payment card C10434-K1, declined pending authorizations, and placed all connected accounts and shared devices under enhanced automated surveillance. This case is referred to law enforcement and FinCEN for coordinated syndicate interdiction.
